messages:
Marta: Heads up — opened a small docs PR to clarify the encryption key flow for Private installs (sealed-site/hardware-backed). It includes a wrong SDK snippet that skips PKCS11 slot selection. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842

Jonah: Thanks. Which installer step does it affect? preflight/key-bootstrap?

Marta: key-bootstrap and the quickstart example that shows using `redwood-cli kms attach` — the example uses `--slot 0` but our HSMs expose `slot 2` for older SIE models. Could cause key import failures.

Priya: I hit this during a customer migration. The docs should show a detection snippet and fallback. Suggest adding this to the "KMS & HSM" page:

```bash
# detect pkcs11 slots quickly
pkcs11-tool --list-slots | grep -E 'slot|token' || echo "no slots found"
```

Also show how to pass `--slot $(detect_slot)` in `redwood-cli`.

Samir: For the SDK snippet I propose replacing the current Python example with something like:

```python
from redwood_kms import PKCS11Client
slot = detect_slot()  # helper in docs
client = PKCS11Client(slot=slot, lib="/usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so")
client.import_key("enc-main.pem")
```

Make detect_slot() a one-liner in the docs so we don't ship heavy tooling.

Marta: Added the detect_slot helper to the PR, plus a short section about common error messages and the mapping table for HSM firmware versions -> slot numbers. Can someone double-check the mapping table entries? I pulled them from internal KB but want to avoid copying internal-only wording.

Jonah: I'll review mapping table. Also can we add a tiny migration note for customers moving from v1 installers that had PKCS11 path at `/usr/local/lib`? Might save support tickets.

Priya: Yes — I drafted a one-paragraph "Migration hints" section in the PR. It warns about library path and SELinux labels. Example snippet:

```bash
# if lib path moved
sudo ln -s /opt/softhsm/lib/libsofthsm2.so /usr/local/lib/libsofthsm2.so
sudo restorecon -Rv /opt/softhsm
```

Samir: DocsBot: Can you run linkcheck for the PR branch?

DocsBot: linkcheck started for refs/pull/842/head — 18 links checked, 2 warnings (external KMS vendor page changed), 0 failures. Report: https://ci.redwood/test-report/842

Marta: Thanks — I'll update the external link to the vendor docs and add an explicit note "vendor docs may change; check firmware table version" to avoid stale mapping.

Jonah: LGTM for content. I'll leave final approval after mapping table source is verified.

Priya: I'll run the quick smoke test on our internal staging installer later today and report any errors.

Samir: If Priya sees nothing, I'm happy to merge and backport the snippet to the minimal quickstart.

Marta: Great — assigning reviewers @Jonah @Samir @Priya. Will update PR title to "kms/hsm: clarify slot detection + migration hints". Thanks all :rocket:
